holdout_policy: Training contains only baseline x86 SSE/AVX-family extensions. Every other x86 extension, including AVX-VNNI, AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, BF16, FP16, AMX, ADX, BMI, AES, SHA, and future Intel extensions, is test-only. RVV is also test-only.
notes: Use Vegen-style Operation graphs as supervision instead of backend assembly mnemonics.
Do not put RVV in training; it is a cross-ISA generalization test.
Do not special-case AVX-512 VNNI as the only x86 test target; it is one member of the non-training x86 extension holdout.
Keep architecture and extension metadata explicit so cross-ISA failures are interpretable.
